# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_doc.py from inventree_woocommerce/core.py - do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are on the plugin's settings page in InvenTree (Admin Center → Plugins → WooCommerce Shop). The WordPress side has its own page: WooCommerce → InvenTree Shop.

## Connection

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop URL | `WOO_URL` | (blank) | Your WordPress/WooCommerce site, e.g. https://shop.example.com (https only). |
| Consumer key | `WOO_CONSUMER_KEY` | (blank) | WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API > Add key, with Read/Write permission. (Stored protected.) |
| Consumer secret | `WOO_CONSUMER_SECRET` | (blank) | Shown once when the REST API key is created. (Stored protected.) |
| Webhook secret | `WOO_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | (blank) | The 'Secret' you enter on the WooCommerce webhook (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Webhooks). Use the same long random value in both places. (Stored protected.) |
| Verify the shop's SSL certificate | `WOO_VERIFY_SSL` | yes | Leave on. Only turn off to test against a staging site with a self-signed certificate. |
| Send API keys as query parameters | `WOO_QUERY_STRING_AUTH` | no | Turn on only if the shop answers 401 even with correct keys - some hosts strip the Authorization header. |

## What goes in the shop

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop parameter | `SHOP_PARAMETER` | `Web Shop` | Part parameter that puts a part in the shop: Yes / Stock = sell from stock only, Build = build to order (backorders allowed), No = keep out (even in the shop category). Parts must also be Active and Salable. |
| Shop category | `SHOP_CATEGORY` | (blank) | Optional: publish every salable part in this category and its subcategories (unless its shop parameter says No). (Pick a part category.) |
| Shop category mode | `CATEGORY_DEFAULT_MODE` | Sell from stock only | How parts published by category are sold when they have no shop parameter. Options: Sell from stock only; Build to order. |
| Lead time parameter | `LEAD_TIME_PARAMETER` | `Lead Time` | Part parameter shown as the lead time on build-to-order products. |
| Default lead time | `DEFAULT_LEAD_TIME` | `6 weeks` | Lead time for build-to-order parts without their own lead time parameter, e.g. '6 weeks'. Shown on the product and used for the Build Order target date. |
| Build-to-order note | `BUILD_NOTE` | (blank) | Shown on every build-to-order product, e.g. 'Call 08 1234 5678 to discuss your requirements.' Blank = none. |
| Parameters shown in the shop | `PUBLISHED_PARAMETERS` | (blank) | Comma-separated part parameter names to show as a specification table on the product page. Blank = none. |
| Product title | `TITLE_SOURCE` | Part name - description | What the product is called in the shop. Options: Part name - description; Part name; Part description. |
| Product SKU | `SKU_SOURCE` | IPN, else part name | Must be unique in the shop. An existing product with the same SKU is adopted instead of duplicated. Options: IPN, else part name; IPN, else INV-<id>; Part name; INV-<id>. |
| Shop currency | `SHOP_CURRENCY` | `AUD` | Must match the WooCommerce store currency. Sale prices in other currencies are converted with InvenTree's exchange rates. |
| Stock reserve | `STOCK_RESERVE` | `0` | Units of each part held back from the shop (e.g. for your own builds). |
| Send part images | `PUSH_IMAGES` | yes | Send each part's image to the shop. |
| Show documents on products | `PUBLISH_DOCUMENTS` | yes | List the part's attachments marked for the shop (drawings, datasheets, pinouts) as downloads on the product page. |
| Document tag | `DOCUMENT_TAG` | `shop` | An attachment is shown in the shop when it has this tag, or '[shop]' (this word in square brackets) in its comment. The rest of the comment becomes the link text. |
| Public InvenTree URL | `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | (blank) | The https:// address the shop can reach InvenTree on, used for image downloads. Blank = InvenTree's own site URL. |
| When a part leaves the shop | `UNPUBLISH_ACTION` | Set to draft | What happens to its WooCommerce product. Options: Set to draft; Set to private; Move to trash. |
| Automatic sync | `AUTO_SYNC` | yes | Re-send a listing as soon as its part, price, parameters or stock change, and re-check the whole shop every 15 minutes. Off = only the Sync endpoint updates the shop. |

## Orders

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid order statuses | `PAID_STATUSES` | `processing,completed` | Comma-separated WooCommerce statuses that mean an order is paid and should become a Sales Order. |
| Customers | `CUSTOMER_MODE` | One InvenTree customer per shop customer | Create an InvenTree customer per shop customer (matched by email), or put every web order under one customer. Options: One InvenTree customer per shop customer; All orders under the shared customer below. |
| Shared customer | `SHARED_CUSTOMER` | (blank) | Used when Customers is set to shared. (Pick a company.) |
| Issue Sales Orders automatically | `ISSUE_ORDERS` | no | Off = new web orders arrive as Pending for you to check and issue. |
| Note the Sales Order on the shop order | `WRITE_BACK_NOTES` | yes | Add a private note to the WooCommerce order with the InvenTree Sales Order reference. |
| Tell the customer about shipments | `PUSH_SHIPMENTS` | yes | When a web order's shipment is completed in InvenTree, email the customer (dispatched, delivered on, tracking) and complete the WooCommerce order once everything has shipped. |

## Credit accounts

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Account parameter | `ACCOUNT_PARAMETER` | `Shop Account` | Company parameter that approves a customer for 'Charge to my account' at checkout (Yes / No). Their logins are matched by the company email and its contacts' emails. |
| Credit limit parameter | `CREDIT_LIMIT_PARAMETER` | `Credit Limit` | Company parameter holding the account's credit limit in the shop currency. Blank = no limit. Checked against what the account owes: open account Sales Orders, plus unpaid Xero invoices when the Xero plugin is installed. |
| Account payment methods | `ACCOUNT_PAYMENT_METHODS` | `inventree_account` | Comma-separated WooCommerce payment method ids that mean 'charge to account'. inventree_account is the companion WordPress plugin's method. |
| Count unpaid Xero invoices | `CREDIT_INCLUDE_XERO` | yes | With the inventree-xero plugin: credit used includes the customer's outstanding Xero balance (invoiced orders are then counted once, from Xero). No effect without it. |
| Sync accounts to the shop | `SYNC_ACCOUNTS` | yes | Keep account approval and available credit up to date on each matching shop login (needed for the companion plugin's 'Charge to my account'). |

## Releasing build-to-order designs

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build to order needs a validated BOM | `BUILD_REQUIRES_VALID_BOM` | yes | Only sell a build-to-order assembly once its BOM is validated in InvenTree. Editing the BOM afterwards takes it out of the shop until it's validated again. |
| Build to order needs a locked part | `BUILD_REQUIRES_LOCKED` | no | Also require the assembly to be locked in InvenTree before it's sold. |

## Quote requests

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shop link secret | `SHOP_SECRET` | (blank) | Long random value shared with the companion WordPress plugin (InvenTree Shop settings). Signs quote requests and the notifications InvenTree sends back to the shop. (Stored protected.) |
| Quotes valid for (days) | `QUOTE_VALID_DAYS` | `30` | How long a sent quote can be accepted. |
| Expiry reminder (days before) | `QUOTE_REMIND_DAYS` | `3` | Email the customer this many days before a quote expires. 0 = no reminder. |
| Largest quote upload (MB) | `QUOTE_MAX_FILE_MB` | `20` | Per file. Make sure your web server allows uploads this big (nginx client_max_body_size). |
| Most files per quote request | `QUOTE_MAX_FILES` | `20` |  |
| Quote upload file types | `QUOTE_FILE_TYPES` | `pdf,png,jpg,jpeg,gif,webp,heic,dxf,dwg,xlsx,xls,csv,docx,doc,txt` | Comma-separated file extensions customers may upload. |
| Quote PDF: your details | `QUOTE_BUSINESS_DETAILS` | (blank) | Printed in the 'From' box of quote PDFs: business name, ABN, address, phone, email. Put each on a new line (or separate with \n). The logo is InvenTree's custom logo. |
| Quote PDF: terms | `QUOTE_TERMS` | (blank) | Printed at the bottom of quote PDFs, e.g. payment terms, warranty, validity. |
| Quote tax rate (%) | `QUOTE_TAX_RATE` | `10` | Added to the quote total on the PDF (prices are entered ex tax). 0 = no tax line. |
| Quote tax name | `QUOTE_TAX_LABEL` | `GST` |  |
| Quote report template | `QUOTE_REPORT_TEMPLATE` | (blank) | Which report template prints quotes (model type 'quote request'). Blank = the first enabled one; the plugin installs 'Quote (web shop)' if there's none. (Pick a report template.) |
| Quote PDF for customers | `QUOTE_PDF_TO_CUSTOMER` | yes | Attach the PDF to the 'your quote is ready' email and let customers download it from My Account > Quotes. |
| Where quotes are priced | `QUOTE_PRICING` | A pricing plugin when one is active, else InvenTree | Another plugin can own quote pricing (inventree-xero: price and send quotes in Xero, with labour and freight lines and Xero's PDF). InvenTree is used whenever none is active. Options: A pricing plugin when one is active, else InvenTree; Always in InvenTree. |

## Build Orders

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build Orders for build-to-order items | `BUILD_ORDERS` | For the quantity not covered by free stock | When a web order includes build-to-order parts, create Build Orders linked to the Sales Order. Options: For the quantity not covered by free stock; For the full quantity ordered; Never. |
